note: The only place an Easel engine's identity is written down. Code reads this file; it never carries a commit literal. `active` selects the engine production resolves, and changing it is an upgrade-gated action (docs/UPSTREAM-EASEL.md), not an edit. Identity is commit plus, when measured, tree digest: upstream force-replaced the v0.3.0 tag while keeping the version number, so a tag is a comment and never an identity. A missing or invalid registry blocks resolution; there is no fallback commit.

v0.2.1.blob_count_basis: files verified by blob_sha1 tree comparison on 2026-11-01; not a total tree count
v0.2.1.note: Production engine since 2026-10-02. Verified by git HEAD plus a 982-blob content comparison; no tree digest was ever computed for it, so this entry says so instead of inventing one.

v0.3.0.note: Adoption candidate, not production. The installed instance path is recorded in the overlay manifest, not here, because it is outside the repository. `root` is the intended location once M1 installs it. Requires the full upgrade gate before `active` may point at it.
